headline: Nigeria SEC Urges Tech Founders to Seek Capital on Local Exchanges
summary: Securities and Exchange Commission Director-General Emomotimi Agama urged Nigerian startup founders to explore domestic debt and crowdfunding channels to pave the way for local stock market listings.
why: Developing domestic equity capital access in Nigeria reduces local tech firms' reliance on foreign venture capital and currency mismatch risks.

impacts.name: Nigerian Capital Markets
impacts.why: Directing local tech companies to domestic exchanges boosts market liquidity and tech sector IPO pipelines.
